description:
Welcome to Build Autopsy.

We take a closer look at how buildings are actually built and how they work behind the scenes.

From the foundation and framing to plumbing, electrical, HVAC, roofing, insulation, drywall, and other parts of construction, we break down the systems and processes that most people never get to see.

Our goal is simple: to make construction easier to understand by showing what is happening inside and behind the finished building.

If you want to understand how houses and buildings really come together, you are in the right place.

Build Autopsy
See What Buildings Hide.
